<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    nodes=seg['nodes']
    # player green = N node with more pixels (12) vs plug (8)
    Ns=[n for n in nodes if n['color']=='N']
    playerN=max(Ns,key=lambda n:n['pixels'])
    plugN=min(Ns,key=lambda n:n['pixels'])
    pg=min(p[1] for p in playerN['boundary'])
    pl=min(p[1] for p in plugN['boundary'])
    # gray left edge per row band
    asc=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def leftedge(r):
        c=0
        while c<64 and asc[r][c]!='G': c+=1
        return c
    edges={ 'top(10)':leftedge(10),'mid(30)':leftedge(30),'bot(55)':leftedge(55)}
    return pg,pl,edges
print("start",state())
for (r,c) in [(45,1),(37,1),(25,1),(17,1)]:
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    print(f"click({r},{c}) score",res['score'],"done",res['done'],"lvlcomp",res['level_completed'],"->",state())
    if res['done'] or res['level_completed']: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
